Team,

Quick regional roll-up ahead of finance's mid-cycle cut: please do a fast pass on any opportunities you plan to *count* toward July and flag them with one of the risk-tags below by EOD (local):

- pricing: outstanding commercial negotiation
- legal: contract redlines or SOC2/clauses outstanding
- exec: requires exec alignment or reference checks
- ops: integration/infra work blocking go-live

What I need from each owner (Karthik/Vanessa/Mina):
1) Confirm deal(s) you intend to commit and set stage -> "Commit - Ready" in HubSpot.
2) Attach the small commit_matrix row (account, ARR, close date, owner, risk-tag).
3) If owner is handing off to another rep for procurement/PEP, note the handoff and new owner explicitly.

A couple of notes: Acme Cloud (see procurement in thread later) is on a legal review timeline — mark as legal/pricing. We should not push it into "Commit" without a signed SOW. Finance asked for visibility so they can model tranches.

Attachment: blank_commit_matrix_template.xlsx (please use this file name when you attach).

Thanks — short and sharp here; I want a single row per deal to feed into the roll-up.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Regional Sales Manager, EMEA
